name: Town of Cortlandt
gaps: The current table sets no building coverage, story count, lot depth or frontage; 'lot coverage' covers all impervious surfaces
No floor-area limit: Attachment 4 (max floor area) was deleted by L.L. 2-2026
R-160 is listed in § 307-5 and the use table but has no row in the July 2026 dimensional table; county code PVD does not exist in Chapter 307
Ch. 283 protected-tree species list (Appendix A to Ch. 283) not read
Split-zoned county codes (with '*') follow each part's rules

wetlands.summary: Ch. 179: wetland buffer area is the land within 100 ft of the outer edge of any wetland, watercourse or water body (§ 179-2); permit needed for grading, filling, structures, septic and other disturbance in wetlands, water bodies, watercourses or the buffer (§ 179-3). Buffer is 150 ft inside the Indian Brook-Croton Gorge Watershed Protection Overlay (§ 307-96.3).

steep_slopes.summary: Ch. 259: permit to disturb, or cut any tree over 4 in. diameter, on steep slopes (over 15%, at least 500 sf with one dimension 10 ft+) (§ 259-3, § 259-4); disturbance of 30%+ slopes only in compelling, exceptional cases.

trees.summary: Ch. 283 § 283-3: permit to cut any tree (over 4 in. diameter at 4.5 ft) except, on developed residential lots up to 4 acres, removal of up to 3 non-protected trees per 12 months not within 10 ft of the property line on lots over 20,000 sf; dead, diseased or emergency removals exempt. Plans removing 4+ trees need a tree inventory.

stormwater.summary: Ch. 262: SWPPP and review for land development activity disturbing 1 acre or more (or part of a larger common plan); Director of Technical Services is Stormwater Management Officer.

adu.summary: § 307-45: one ADU per lot where single-family homes are allowed; owner-occupied; building permit plus 3-year operating permit; detached ADUs need a Planning Board special permit; max 800 sf or 40% of the house GFA (whichever is less; basement ADUs may exceed 800 sf up to 40%); max 2 bedrooms; detached ADU not in front yard or street-facing corner side yard, no taller than the house.

general.accessory_structures: Sheds/detached garages: 6 ft side and rear, 17 ft high, not in the front yard. Other accessory structures (pools, decks, patios, sport courts): district side yard and district rear yard, except 6 ft rear in R-G/R-10 and 10 ft rear in R-15/R-20. Total accessory footprint max = house footprint, any one max 70% (Attachment 3 notes). Patios, retaining walls and impervious surfaces may go in setbacks with DOTS approval (§ 307-18H).
general.pools: Pools are 'other accessory structures': not in the front yard; district side yard; district rear yard except 6 ft (R-G, R-10) or 10 ft (R-15, R-20); count toward lot coverage.
general.notes: Corner lots: every street-facing yard is a front yard for the house; accessory structures in the street-facing side yard need the lesser of double the district setback or the front yard (§ 307-18G). Front yard may be reduced to the average of neighbors within 500 ft (§ 307-18A). Flag lots need 50 ft frontage and the flagpole is excluded from lot area (§ 307-18I).

R-80.name: Single-Family Residential (80,000 sf)

max_impervious_coverage.note: Lot coverage: all buildings, structures and impervious surfaces incl. driveways, walks, decks, patios, pools, sport courts (§ 307-4 as amended by L.L. 2-2026)

accessory.notes: Sheds, detached garages and other accessory buildings (no ADU): 6 ft side and rear, 17 ft max to the highest point, not in the front yard. Pools, decks, coops, sport courts, patios etc.: district side yard and district rear yard (30 ft) rear. Accessory building with an ADU: district yards, no taller than the house. All accessory footprints together max = house footprint; any one max 70% of it. Structures under 25 sf exempt (not compressors, generators, tanks, BESS).

R-80.source: § 307-17 Table of Dimensional Regulations, Residential Districts (307 Attachment 3, Supp 15 Jul 2026, as replaced by L.L. 2-2026); § 307-18G (corner lots)
R-80.notes: Height measured to the highest point of the structure from average finished grade within 20 ft; each story max 12 ft (except R-G). Former floor-area table (Attachment 4) deleted by L.L. 2-2026.
